label: Best time
value: End of September is the advised trekking time; the Kalam and Swat trekking guide adds the lakes are best in summer
source: Lost With Purpose, Guide to day trekking in Kalam
quote: The best time to go trekking in Kalam and Swat Valley is the end of September.

label: Hike from Ladu Valley
value: About 3 hours of steep climb after the wooden bridge, on whatever tracks are found
source: Lost With Purpose, Guide to day trekking in Kalam
quote: follow whatever tracks you can find straight uphill

label: Time for the day
value: 4 to 5 hours for one lake from Ladu Valley
source: Lost With Purpose, Guide to day trekking in Kalam
quote: Time: 4-5 hours for one lake if starting from Ladu Valley.

label: Altitude
value: About 3,180 m at the place point (Copernicus DEM); the mapped path ends about 140 m lower
source: Copernicus GLO-30 DEM, sampled by the TinyAtlas build
quote: DEM value sampled at 35.43375, 72.45202 (3180.7 m) and at the path end 35.42289, 72.43378 (3042.1 m)
